## Triage: first grade, `bug` · `priority:p3` · `domain:ui` · `area:studio`, into `pm:queue`. Wording only: the copy names the environment overlay

Triage seat (seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-12T01:52Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Lane:** `packages/app-shell` i18n plus the console guide row, so `domain:ui`. The card carried no labels and is graded here.
- **Why p3:** shipped copy names a retired axis (ADR-0131 D6). The Studio home shows it to every Studio user, but nothing behaves wrongly.
- **Direction, as the card says:**
  - Change the values only. ⛔ No new keys.
  - Cover every pack that carries the three keys (the claim measures all ten), and the `console.md:37` row.
  - ⛔ Which items the overlay can reach is objectui#12169's question, not this card's.
- **Pins:** a test that no shipped pack value for the three keys names the organization axis. Read it from the packs, not from a hand list of locales.
- **Sequence:** after PR objectui#12168 (objectui#12141), which holds `i18n.ts` and `console.md`. This is ordering, not a block. It can ride the same claim as objectui#12169, since both are the same seat's and come from the same rename.
- `Clause-②: no`.

Claim: PM loop round 4 (the copy names the environment overlay, as filed and as triage `6116349827` grades: values only, the `console.md:37` row, a pin read from the packs)
Session: `session_016djJF12Qt14ejKR5Vjt4sK`
Account: `os-steve`
Branch: `claude/issue-12171-environment-overlay-copy`
Worktree: `objectui-issue-12171`
Domain: `domain:ui`
Seat: `domain:ui#1`
File surface, re-measured on objectui `main` `2498a07`:
- `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts`: the values of `engine.studio.landing.description`, `.readonlyHint` and `.overlayTitle`. en `:3019`, `:3032`, `:3034`; zh `:6229`, `:6241`, `:6243`. The three keys live only in this module-local table, not in the ten `@object-ui/i18n` packs. Their reader is `views/studio-design/BuilderLanding.tsx`.
- `content/docs/guide/console.md:37`, the "Read-only Packages in Studio" row.
- Code comments next to the renamed key that still say "per-org overlay" / "ORG OVERLAY", if the dev takes them along. They are not user-visible.
- One new pin, and `.changeset/12171-environment-overlay-copy.md`.
- ⛔ No key is added or removed, and the `@object-ui/i18n` packs do not change. (Stop on breach; explain in the report.)
Container & model: `S`, `mode:subagent`, `model: default tier — dispatch-gates --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectui: "no path-derived mandate"`
Clause-②: no
Responsibility: `objectui's Studio landing copy and console guide: three shipped strings (en and zh) and one docs row offer an "org overlay" | ADR-0131 D6 retired the per-organization overlay axis, and objectstack#22340 S2 renamed the flag to what it now means (allowEnvironmentOverlay) | every Studio user, on the Studio home`
Thread-read: 6116349827
Serial constraints cleared: read at 2026-10-12T02:46Z on objectui `main` `2498a07`:
- objectui#12141 (PR objectui#12168), which held `i18n.ts` and `console.md`, landed as `e531116`.
- This seat's objectui#12169, claimed in the same act, is `area:studio` too, but on the edit gates (`ResourceEditPage`, `PermissionMatrixEditor`, `DirectoryPage`, `PageShell`). It touches neither these three keys nor `console.md`. Disjoint surfaces, so both may be in flight.
- No open objectui PR touches these files.

## Claim amendment: one more shipped string, same class, same file · `domain:ui` seat 1 · `session_016djJF12Qt14ejKR5Vjt4sK` · 2026-10-12T03:10Z

This amends claim `6116835562`. The trigger is the out-of-scope finding in the dev report `6117032711` on PR objectui#12177.

- **Added to the surface:** the en and zh values of `perm.readOnly.artifact.hint` in `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts` (en `:2520`, zh `:5782` on `main` `2498a07`).
  - `PermissionMatrixEditor` renders it on every code-shipped permission set.
  - Its parenthetical says "ADR-0005 forbids per-org overlay of a packaged set" / 「按组织覆盖」, which names the axis ADR-0131 D6 retired.
  - It is the same class, the same file and the same gate family, and the card's direction ("the copy names the axis that exists") covers it. The bound: values only, no key, and the rest of each sentence unchanged.
- **Also allowed:** the code comments that describe these same strings, namely the one above the en `readonlyHint` in `i18n.ts` and `BuilderLanding.tsx`'s doc comments. They are not user-visible; the dev decides.
- **Not added:**
  - Comments in `PermissionMatrixEditor.tsx`, `PageShell.tsx` and `ResourceEditPage*` and their tests. objectui#12169's dev holds those files in this round; carrier: that card.
  - The pending `.changeset/11808-readonly-package-card.md`. Its "org overlay" / `allowOrgOverride` wording describes that change as it shipped. Pending changesets that name the old key stay as history, as objectui#12141's claim `6115250926` set, and `.changeset/12141-allow-environment-overlay.md` carries the rename in the same release.
- **The pin:** it covers the added key too. A value naming the organization axis fails it, and the control asserts the environment axis.
- `Clause-②: no` is unchanged.

## What changes

ADR-0131 D6 (objectstack `main`, the sentence "ADR-0005's per-organization overlay axis is retired") leaves one overlay axis, the environment: the registry flag is `allowEnvironmentOverlay`, "may an environment overlay this packaged item" (objectstack#22340 S2). The Studio home still offered an "org overlay", and the permission matrix's hint on a packaged set still said "per-org overlay". Both now name the environment overlay, and so does the console guide.

Round 2 follows the claim amendment `6117050593`, which added `perm.readOnly.artifact.hint` to this card.

- `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts`: the values of three landing keys, in both tables, en and zh. ⛔ No key is added or removed.
  - `engine.studio.landing.description`: "… customize them with an environment overlay." / 「…并用环境覆盖进行定制。」
  - `engine.studio.landing.readonlyHint`: "Customize one with an environment overlay, for the metadata types that accept one." / 「对于接受环境覆盖的元数据类型，可用环境覆盖（overlay）进行定制。」
  - `engine.studio.landing.overlayTitle`: "… each type shows whether it accepts an environment overlay" / 「…是否接受环境覆盖」
  - Each sentence keeps its structure; only the noun changes ("org overlay" to "environment overlay", 「组织覆盖」 to 「环境覆盖」).
- Same file, the hint `PermissionMatrixEditor` shows on a set a code package ships, `perm.readOnly.artifact.hint`. Only its parenthetical changes, in both languages:
  - en: "(ADR-0005 forbids per-org overlay of a packaged set: silent privilege drift)" becomes "(ADR-0131 D6 forbids an environment overlay of a packaged set: silent privilege drift)".
  - zh: 「（ADR-0005 禁止对已打包权限集做按组织覆盖：会造成权限静默漂移）」 becomes 「（ADR-0131 D6 禁止对已打包权限集做环境覆盖：会造成权限静默漂移）」.
  - Why ADR-0131 D6 and not ADR-0005: read on objectstack `main` (`018b077fb`), D6 restates the prohibition. "No door edits a managed definition", the overlay regime is limited to "the five presentational types", and its customer-needs table answers "define their own roles" with "managed sets read-only, clonable". The rationale "silent privilege drift" is ADR-0005's security row ("Authorization correctness; overlays would create silent privilege drift"), whose environment layer D6 keeps "exactly as today, with the per-organization axis retired".
- Comments only, not user-visible: the note above the en `readonlyHint` in `i18n.ts` and four doc comments in `BuilderLanding.tsx` said "org overlay" and now say "environment overlay" (the amendment allows them).
- `content/docs/guide/console.md`, row "Read-only Packages in Studio": "Whether an item can take an environment overlay is decided per metadata type (`allowEnvironmentOverlay`)". Only that noun phrase changes.
- A pin, `packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/BuilderLanding.environmentOverlayCopy-12171.test.ts`, and the changeset `.changeset/12171-environment-overlay-copy.md` (`@object-ui/app-shell` patch).

Which items an overlay can reach is not touched here; that is objectui#12169's question.

## Where the three keys live (measured on `main` `2498a07`)

- Only in the metadata-admin designer's module-local table, `ENGINE_STRINGS_EN` / `ENGINE_STRINGS_ZH` in `views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts`. Their one reader is `views/studio-design/BuilderLanding.tsx`.
- The ten `@object-ui/i18n` packs do not carry them. Outside that table and its reader, `git grep` for the three key names hits two comments (one in the en pack, one in an i18n test) and no value.
- So "every pack that carries the three keys" resolves to the two tables this module declares: en and zh. Its `SupportedLocale` union is `'en-US' | 'zh-CN'`, and the module header records that the other eight shipped locales render English on these screens. The `@object-ui/i18n` packs are unchanged.

## The pin

Triage asked for "a test that no shipped pack value for the three keys names the organization axis", read "from the packs, not from a hand list of locales".
